options.name: aclHostEnable
options.description: When true directs the server to use the acl_hosts access list for the named queue

options.name: cloneFrom
options.description: The id or name of the entity that the new entity will be cloned from.  (take effect only at entity creation)

options.name: defaultQueue
options.description: Specifies the queue which is to accept jobs when no queue is requested

options.name: defaultWalltime
options.description: Default maximum runtime of jobs running in a queue

options.name: enabled
options.description: When true, a queue will accept new jobs; when false, a queue is disabled and will not accept jobs

options.name: fromRouteOnly
options.description: Receive jobs from route queues only

options.name: maxQueued
options.description: Maximum number allowed to reside in a queue at any given time (0 is the same as infinite)

options.name: maxRunning
options.description: Maximum number of jobs allowed to run at any given time (0 is the same as infinite)

options.name: maxWalltime
options.description: Maximum runtime of jobs running in a queue

options.name: minWalltime
options.description: Minimum runtime of jobs running in a queue

options.name: name
options.description: Name of queue

options.name: options
options.description: Additional parameters that will be passed to the WLM queue configuration

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority of a queue against other queues of the same type [-1024; 1024]

options.name: queueType
options.description: Pbs Pro queue type

options.name: routeHeldJobs
options.description: Specifies whether jobs in the held state can be routed from this queue

options.name: routeLifetime
options.description: The maximum time a job is allowed to reside in a routing queue

options.name: routeRetryTime
options.description: Route retry time in routing queue

options.name: routeWaitingJobs
options.description: Specifies whether jobs whose execution_time attribute value is in the future can be routed from this queue

options.name: routes
options.description: Route of queue path (route_destination parameter in qmgr)

options.name: started
options.description: Jobs may be scheduled for execution from this queue; when false, a queue is considered stopped

options.name: state
options.description: The state the resource should have

options.name: wlmCluster
options.description: WlmCluster to which this node belongs
